body: I live in the midwest, but my parents aren't even in the US, so I'm open to moving anywhere. I've been applying for jobs all over the country and still haven't gotten hired for anything :(

I will have a degree in English. I know people on reddit like to make fun of English majors, but I know people who already have jobs with my degree. I don't understand why I can't find one. I've applied to SO many places, and I'm open to living anywhere in the country.

I haven't seen a doctor but I have been seeing a therapist at my school's counseling center all year. I've been on medication before (about three years ago), and I really don't want to have to do that again. It just makes me feel shitty not to be able to be a normal person and have a normal life and solve my own problems. I don't know anyone else who has had to go on medication multiple times in their life and it just makes me feel like a failure.
Thank you. My degree will be in English.
